operator-walkthrough.ref: 2026-10-21 Billed card on the Today page (SalesCard). Nour sees six chips in order: Today, Yesterday, 7 days, 30 days, This month, Last month; 7 days is still the selected one on load. Whether a day is synced is read from the ShopDriver sync log (the newest successful probe), not from the newest invoice. Tap Today on a normal morning, before any ShopDriver sync has run today: the card shows 'Not synced yet today. Last ShopDriver sync: <date> 8:00 PM ET.' and no dollar figure, no invoice count, no 'What this excludes' button (a $0 there would read as a dead shop), even if a manual or booking invoice was written today. Tap Yesterday: once a sync has run after yesterday ended it shows the figure, 'N invoices · Yesterday' and 'current as of <date time> ET'; before that it says 'Not synced yet for yesterday.' Once a sync has run today, Today shows its figure 'so far today, as of 11:42 AM ET'; a synced day with no invoices (a holiday) shows a real $0 with '0 invoices'. If the sync log cannot be read the day says 'Sync status unknown' with no figure. A failed read on either chip still shows 'Sales unreadable: this is UNKNOWN, not $0'. The longer periods keep their figure and now end the basis line with 'current as of <date time> ET'. Other chips are unchanged. Also (Nour's choice, 2026-10-21, 'Refresh syncs anytime'): opening or refreshing ANY admin tab (the shell asks once the admin is ready, not only the Today page) syncs ShopDriver, at most once per 30 minutes, any hour; whenever the server reports a ShopDriver probe running (this load's, an OAuth login's, chat's, a second tab's or a manual sync-now), a small 'Syncing the invoice mirror from ShopDriver' line shows on the Billed card and it re-reads every 15 s for up to 3 minutes, so a Today that read 'Not synced yet today' turns into the figure by itself. Tapping chips or coming back to the page without a refresh does not sync again, but a first call the server refuses (MFA not yet cleared) does not use the page load up; each sync logs the shop counter out of ShopDriver, which Nour accepted. 'Synced' now means a ShopDriver run that actually fetched invoices: a run whose invoice fetch returned 0 is logged as an error and never counts. Evidence (round 2): client/src/__tests__/sync-on-admin-load.test.tsx (shell trigger, refused first call), server/services/algProbeBudget.test.ts (outcome rules, real start time, recordExternalSync). Evidence: client/src/__tests__/sales-card.test.tsx (day chips and the sync-once/poll behaviour; the whole file red before the change), server/shopSales.test.ts (day windows in America/New_York across 23:00/01:00 ET and both DST days, the windowSynced table driven through the real read with a mocked database: zero-sale day with a probe today is $0, a manual invoice with no probe today is not synced, failed probes do not count, an unreadable probe log is unknown; router/service/card period parity) and server/lib/adminActivity.refreshSync.test.ts (31 min fires, 29 min does not, the age comes from SQL, a plain admin touch never fires, one probe at a time, a failed probe stays out of the request, and a probe whose log insert failed still holds off the next load for 30 min; mutation 'drop the in-process floor' turns 3 red).
